categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of LED backlight display modules, which are core components used in liquid crystal displays (LCD). The company also operates in related areas including smartphone backlight sources and professional display applications. The company has established subsidiaries including Wan載南極光 (manufacturing), 香港南極光 (import/export), and 宜春南極光 (investment operations).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in vacuum compression molding technology for light guide plates, which is at the industry-leading level. Core manufacturing processes include film cutting, plastic injection molding for light guide plates, SMT (surface mount technology) for LED soldering on FPC (flexible printed circuits), and automated assembly. The company employs advanced equipment including high-speed injection molding machines, precision CNC machining, laser etching, and automated optical inspection (AOI) systems. The company has developed Mini-LED backlight source products and maintains capabilities in optical microstructure design and display technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves LCD display module manufacturers including BOE, HuaXian Optoelectronics, Huaxing Optoelectronics, Dijing Optoelectronics, Xinli Optoelectronics, Lianchuang Electronics, Tongxingda, and Qunzhi Optoelectronics. End-market applications include smartphones (OPPO, VIVO, Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, Samsung, LG, Transsion, Lenovo) and professional display sectors (automotive displays, medical displays, industrial control displays, home appliances, consumer electronics). The company's 2023 global smartphone backlight module market share was approximately 6.00%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province. Manufacturing facilities are located in Shenzhen (Baoan District) and Wanzhou, Jiangxi Province. The company has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong (香港南極光) for import/export operations and in Yichun, Jiangxi Province (宜春南極光) for investment purposes. In 2023, domestic sales accounted for 93.75% of revenue while overseas sales represented 6.25%, with operations extending to international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the LED display supply chain, positioned between upstream LED chip and material suppliers and downstream LCD module manufacturers and end-product brands. The company sources raw materials including FPC, LED chips, optical films (brightness enhancement, diffusion, reflection, light-blocking films), plastic pellets, and metal frames, then manufactures integrated backlight display modules for sale to LCD module assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company maintains strategic focus on LED backlight display technology with emphasis on lightweight, ultra-narrow bezel, and irregularly-shaped designs. R&D priorities include high brightness and uniform illumination, energy efficiency, and new technology development. The company is actively researching Mini-LED and Micro-LED technologies for next-generation display applications. In 2023, R&D expenses were 35.19 million yuan (7.50% of revenue), with 167 R&D personnel. The company holds 295 patents including 24 invention patents, 266 utility model patents, and 5 design patents.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of LED backlight display modules to LCD module manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered and verified by customers. The company employs a make-to-order production model based on customer orders. For standard sales, revenue is recognized upon customer warehouse verification; for supplier-managed inventory (VMI) arrangements, revenue is recognized when customers actually withdraw products. Export sales revenue is recognized after customs clearance and customer verification. In 2023, 100% of revenue came from direct sales of backlight display modules and related products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Ruiyi Optoelectronics (Taiwan-listed), Korean e-LITECOM, Japanese Mabea Group, Longli Technology (Shenzhen-listed), Dongwan Sanxie Precision Technology, Baoming Technology (Shenzhen-listed), Weizhi Holdings (Hong Kong-listed), and Shenzhen Yamamoto Optoelectronics. The company has established itself as a leading supplier to major LCD module manufacturers and smartphone brands, with competitive advantages in vacuum compression molding technology, customer relationships, integrated production capabilities, advanced equipment, quality management systems, and rapid customer response capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 468.99 million yuan, representing a 26.98% decline from 642.27 million yuan in 2022. The company reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of 305.25 million yuan in 2023 compared to a loss of 45.48 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1,512.25 million yuan at year-end 2023 (up 16.97% from 1,292.84 million yuan in 2022), while shareholders' equity was 1,058.77 million yuan (up 29.79% from 815.75 million yuan). The significant loss in 2023 was primarily due to asset impairment charges of 103.26 million yuan, increased stock-based compensation expenses, and reduced product demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced vacuum compression molding technology enabling superior light guide plate precision and optical performance. Key value propositions include: (1) Complete integrated production capabilities from film cutting through final assembly, ensuring quality control and cost efficiency; (2) Advanced manufacturing equipment including high-speed injection molding and precision optical inspection systems; (3) Comprehensive quality management systems (ISO9001, ISO14001, QC080000, IATF16949) ensuring product reliability; (4) Rapid response to customer needs with customized product design and quick delivery; (5) Long-term stable relationships with leading LCD module manufacturers and smartphone brands; (6) Continuous innovation in optical design and manufacturing processes to achieve higher brightness, uniformity, and energy efficiency.
